chapter: Lincoln Park and the name Kid
title: Bolden and Robichaux competing at Lincoln Park
summary: Bolden's band played the skating rink while Robichaux played the pavilion, drawing the crowd with a horn out the window.

blocks.x: And he was very, very, very good looking. I've seen pictures of him. I'm so, what did you say? I used to see what his father looked like. He was so doggone good looking, it wasn't even funny. Yeah, I have a picture of that. He's in the bottom of the trunk out in the garage so it wouldn't get ruined.

And finished telling you, before I started playing there, you know. Yeah. When I used to go from Laplace, you know. Yes. Robichoux used to play every Sunday, afternoon, Sunday night. Uh huh. But the Bowling would play out, well, Malling Bird or Milling Bird, they called it then. Yeah. And that night Bowling would come, they'd have a skating ring in the afternoon in the, you know. Uh huh. One place would dance in the pavilion, the balloon would go up, but it probably used to go in the balloon. Well, that night, Buddy Bowling would come in and wake the skating ring and have the dance. Both places would run. You know, on the same ground.

They were both playing in the same ground. Same ground, yeah. Same ground. In Lincoln Park? Yes. One in the pavilion and the other on the skating rink. Yeah, sure. How far apart were the pavilion in the skating rink? Well, I'd say about 75 feet. Must have been a lot of music in that part.
